([enterprise.defillama.com](https://enterprise.defillama.com/unlocks/megaeth-bridge?utm_source=openai))

([enterprise.defillama.com](https://enterprise.defillama.com/unlocks/megaeth-bridge?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: The MEGA/EUR symbol is consistent with MegaETH: Kraken identifies MEGA as MegaETH and supports MEGA/EUR. ([kraken.com](https://www.kraken.com/convert/mega/eur?utm_source=openai))

MegaETH’s official token page says Fluffle recipients received 50% on April 30, 2026, with the remainder vesting over six months—supporting recurring near-term release risk. ([megaeth.com](https://www.megaeth.com/token?utm_source=openai))

MegaETH’s official allocation describes a fixed 10B-token supply, with 53.3% reserved for KPI rewards and material allocations to VC, team, and ecosystem categories. ([static.megaeth.com](https://static.megaeth.com/MiCA%20Crypto-Asset%20White%20Paper%20-%20MEGA%20Token.pdf?utm_source=openai))
No fresh, directly corroborated exploit, chain outage, exchange maintenance/delisting, or regulatory action specific to MegaETH was identified in the reviewed current results.
